title: NECO Civic Education Part 1: National Values, Rights, Citizenship & Social Conduct - Civic Education - Responsible Parenthood
exam: NECO Civic Education Part 1: National Values, Rights, Citizenship & Social Conduct
subject: Civic Education

questions.q: The willingness and ability of parents to cater adequately to the basic physical, emotional, educational, and moral needs of their offspring is termed...
options: foster parenting.
responsible parenthood.
kinship adoption.
juvenile welfare.
questions.explain: **Responsible parenthood** is the capacity of parents to guide, nurture, and provide for the basic life needs (such as food, shelter, education, moral upbringing, and healthcare) of their children according to their family resources.
questions.exam: NECO Civic Education Part 1: National Values, Rights, Citizenship & Social Conduct
questions.subject: Civic Education

questions.q: Which of the following is a primary moral and social duty of responsible parents in the upbringing of their children?
options: Inculcating ethnic hatred and bias towards other tribes
Instilling discipline, integrity, and respect for societal laws
Encouraging early school withdrawal for street trading
Shielding children from lawful punishment when they commit crimes
questions.explain: A core role of responsible parents is moral guidance—**instilling positive values, discipline, sound character, and civic responsibility** in their children so they grow up to be productive members of society.
questions.exam: NECO Civic Education Part 1: National Values, Rights, Citizenship & Social Conduct
questions.subject: Civic Education

questions.q: A couple plans their family size strictly according to their income, ensures all their children acquire formal education, and provides regular medical care and affection. This couple is demonstrating...
options: political socialization.
responsible parenthood.
coercive discipline.
authoritarian parenting.
questions.explain: Family planning, adequate provision of nutritious food, medical healthcare, quality education, and emotional stability within the limits of family income are classic hallmarks of **responsible parenthood**.
questions.exam: NECO Civic Education Part 1: National Values, Rights, Citizenship & Social Conduct
questions.subject: Civic Education

questions.q: Responsible parenthood contributes significantly to national development primarily by...
options: increasing the population of uneducated and idle youths.
raising disciplined, educated, and law-abiding citizens.
escalating the rate of juvenile delinquency and street begging.
reducing the total tax revenue collected by the government.
questions.explain: The family is the basic unit of society. When parents nurture and educate their children properly, they produce **disciplined, highly skilled, and patriotic citizens** who drive economic productivity and promote peace in the country.
questions.exam: NECO Civic Education Part 1: National Values, Rights, Citizenship & Social Conduct
questions.subject: Civic Education

questions.q: Which of the following is **NOT** a negative social consequence of parental neglect and irresponsible parenthood?
options: High prevalence of juvenile delinquency and street children
Increased vulnerability of youths to cultism and drug abuse
Effective and impartial enforcement of constitutional laws
Surge in the rate of child labour and child exploitation
questions.explain: Parental neglect causes social vices such as child abuse, child labour, cultism, and delinquency. **Impartial enforcement of constitutional laws** is a legal and governmental function that is completely unrelated to parental failure.
